authority_boundary: DAD pipeline events are append-only candidate metadata. They do not override source repo authority, satisfy human gates, approve public release, or authorize writes outside repo-local event/mail adapters.
cloud_boundary: Cloud mirrors are deferred and may carry only public-safe metadata after human review.
mailbox_edge_boundary: Mail remains the repo-facing presentation adapter; the event log is central candidate state and does not imply target adoption.
